Nearshore Staff Augmentation Company with
Elite Engineering Talent
body: Finding top-performing talent is exhausting, we can make it easy.
Our engineers are pre-vetted, trained, and team-ready, working in your time zone and embedded in your workflow from day one. Focus on growth; we handle the rest.

sections.heading: Our engineers have helped leading companies ship faster, scale smarter, and build better. And they’re ready to do the same for you.
We help you scale with expert teams in the areas that move your product forward. From code to quality, and design to delivery, our engineers are ready to jump in, contribute fast, and drive results.

Whatever You Need,
Without the Overhead
sections.body: Full-time, part-time, or just a few hours a week — we adapt to your needs without rigid scopes, bloated processes, or the overhead of traditional hires. You get embedded engineers who work your hours and tools, without adding to your salary costs, benefits burden, tax liability, or internal admin time. No project padding. No hidden costs. Just the team you need, ready to go.

sections.eyebrow: Every Hour Counts, But Most Are Lost
sections.heading: You’re Paying for 40 Hours. But Getting 24.
body: Research shows that in a typical 40-hour week, only 24 hours are truly productive. Meetings, multitasking, distractions, even lunch — it adds up to 16 hours of lost time every week. And that’s time your projects can’t afford to lose.

sections.eyebrow: We Cover the Time That Slows You Down
sections.heading:
Your Team, Focused
and Fully Aligned.
sections.body: Unlike traditional offshore models, you won’t be waiting for answers overnight or waking up to blockers. Our engineers stay aligned through internal syncs, KPI reviews, trainings, team check-ins, and even lunch — without pulling focus from your goals. We call those 8 extra hours NS Time, built into our model so your team can keep moving without interruptions.

sections.heading: **English-Speaking** Latin American **Talent** Aligned to **Your Work Hours**.
sections.body: Time zone overlap allows Latin American talent to work in sync with U.S. teams, enabling seamless real-time collaboration and increased productivity.
